expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Source (2026-11-04): the Hugging Face parquet files hf/data/{train,validation,test}-*.parquet (eltorio/ROCOv2-radiology), column image_id, read with pandas. One row is one image and its caption, so images, studies, patients and rows are the image_id count of each split. The source has no patient ID, so patient_id is the image ID. Each image ID holds its split name (ROCOv2_2023_train_000001), so no patient is in 2 splits. The paper (Rueckert et al., Sci Data 2024) gives train 59,958, validation 9,904 and test 9,927 (79,789). The Hugging Face card and parquet have 59,962 train images, 4 more than the paper. The paper does not explain the difference.
